non_refinement.copied_model: A copied implementation model is NOT a source-connected refinement: a Rust or Lean re-implementation of the selected Song body, however faithful, shares no checked denotation with the executing Slang source and closes no row.
non_refinement.differential_suite: A differential suite is NOT a source-connected refinement: equal or differing outputs on sampled inputs are evidence about two executions, not a checked denotation of the Slang body by the canonical definition.
non_refinement.equal_outputs: Equal outputs are NOT a source-connected refinement: agreement on a test corpus does not establish that the executing body denotes the canonical object on its matched domain.
non_refinement.body_change_rule: Changing a selected actual Song body without changing its represented program must be rejected: the source-semantics link is a function of the actual body, so a body mutation that preserves the stated represented program is exactly the change the link must fail to accept.

entries.title: mergeAcc scalar addition
entries.represented_program: The binary merge parameter `f : V -> V -> V` of `Apeiron.Table.insertWith` and `Apeiron.Table.build`, instantiated at scalar addition: `mergeAcc(left, right) = left + right` on bounded machine integers. The represented program is the merge function, not the table that folds it.
entries.observation_relation: For a key `x` and a stream `kvs`, `Apeiron.Table.get (Apeiron.Table.build mergeAcc d kvs) x` is the fold of `mergeAcc` over that key's values in stream order, the equation named by `Apeiron.Table.get_build_acc`. The relation is stated as an anchor, not checked; no denotation from the Song machine integer to the canonical scalar exists.
entries.input_grammar: Two arguments `left` and `right`, each a bounded machine integer. No byte input, no input consumption and no trailing-input policy; the body is a pure call, not a stream reader.
entries.state_effects: None. The body reads no `memory[]` cell and writes no `memory[]` cell. The in-tree laws `mergeacc_comm` and `mergeacc_assoc` are Song laws, not canonical Lean.
entries.refusal: None. The body admits every pair of machine integers. The in-tree laws carry the domain `0 <= left, right <= COORD_CEILING`, but the executing body has no guard and computes for every pair; an out-of-domain value is outside the matched domain but is not refused.
entries.missing: MISSING: a checked Slang source-semantics link from the executing `mergeAcc` body to the canonical merge parameter, and any executing refinement of the fold. `mergeacc_comm` and `mergeacc_assoc` are in-tree Song laws and do not establish the link.

entries.title: tableGet read
entries.represented_program: The total canonical read `Apeiron.Table.get`: return the value stored at `key`. The body locates the slot with `tableFind` and reads it with `tableSlotVal`; the represented program is the read at an occupied key.
entries.observation_relation: At an occupied key the raw word returned by `tableGet` is intended to equal the value read by `Apeiron.Table.get`; `Apeiron.Table.get_insertWith_self` names the read-back equation at a written key. The canonical read is total with a stored default, while the Song read returns the sentinel `-1` for a missing key; the relation is stated, not checked.
entries.input_grammar: Arguments `base`, `cap` and `key`; `base` and `cap` describe a caller-owned `memory[]` extent of `2*cap` cells. No byte input and no input consumption.
entries.state_effects: None. A read does not write; `tableFind` and `tableSlotVal` read `memory[]` only.
entries.refusal: A missing key, an empty probe slot, an invalid capacity or the reserved key `-1` all return the raw word `-1`, which is overloaded across those cases and is not a status. The canonical read has no refusal.
entries.missing: MISSING: a checked Slang source-semantics link from `tableGet` to `Apeiron.Table.get` and any executing refinement. The missing-key sentinel and the canonical stored default are unresolved.

entries.title: tableInsertWith replacement and accumulator write
entries.represented_program: The canonical `Apeiron.Table.insertWith f k v m`: for an existing key store and return `f value old`; for a fresh key store and return `value`. The selected merge is the accumulator face (`old + value`) on the existing-key path, while the fresh-key path stores `value` without adding a default. The body is the write operation, not `Apeiron.Table.build`.
entries.observation_relation: For an existing key, `Apeiron.Table.get (Apeiron.Table.insertWith mergeAcc k v m) k = mergeAcc v (m k)`; for a different key the map is unchanged. The corpus equations `Apeiron.Table.get_insertWith_self` and `Apeiron.Table.get_insertWith_ne` name the relation. The relation is stated, not checked.
entries.input_grammar: Arguments `base`, `cap`, `key`, `value` and `merge`; the caller owns a `memory[]` extent of `2*cap` cells. No byte input; the merge code is an integer in the range `MERGE_SET..MERGE_ACC`.
entries.state_effects: The body writes the located slot in place: `tableSlotSet` for a fresh key and `tableSlotValSet` for an existing key. The caller memory is mutated and there is no rollback.
entries.refusal: Invalid capacity, the reserved key `-1`, an out-of-range merge code or probe exhaustion returns `-1` before any slot write. Earlier successful calls in a sequence remain visible, so the multi-insert is not transactional.
entries.missing: MISSING: a checked Slang source-semantics link from `tableInsertWith` to `Apeiron.Table.insertWith` and any executing refinement. The absent default on a fresh write and the non-transactional post-state are unresolved.

entries.title: tableInit empty layout
entries.represented_program: The constant-default canonical table `Apeiron.Table.build f d [] = fun _ => d`: initialize `cap` slots to the empty key and the zero value. The represented program is the empty table construction, not a build over a stream.
entries.observation_relation: After `tableInit` returns `0`, every slot key reads the reserved empty key; the canonical object is the total function `Apeiron.Table.HMap K V`. The relation is stated as an anchor, not checked; no denotation from the caller `memory[]` to `Apeiron.Table.HMap` exists.
entries.input_grammar: Arguments `base` and `cap`; the caller owns a `memory[]` extent of `2*cap` cells. No byte input and no input consumption.
entries.state_effects: Writes `2*cap` cells: each slot key is set to the empty key and each value to `0` through `tableInitGo` and `tableSlotSet`. The caller memory is mutated and there is no rollback.
entries.refusal: `tableInit` returns the raw word `-1` without writes when `tableCapacityOk(cap)` is `0`, that is for a non-positive or non-power-of-two capacity. The raw word is overloaded and is not a status.
entries.missing: MISSING: a checked Slang source-semantics link from `tableInit` to the canonical constant-default table and any executing refinement. The caller's address extent is a separate caller obligation.

entries.title: headReduce one head step
entries.represented_program: The canonical `Apeiron.Combinator.Comb.headReduce`: fire one head redex on already-reduced children. The `TAG_I`, `TAG_IOTA`, `TAG_K` and `S`-head shapes are the four arms; a term with no head redex is rebuilt.
entries.observation_relation: `Apeiron.Combinator.Comb.headReduce_sound` states `Reduces c (headReduce c)`, so the canonical one-step reduction reaches the reduced term. The Song body is intended to implement that one step, but no denotation from the Song arena to `Apeiron.Combinator.Comb` is established.
entries.input_grammar: Arguments `fl`, `fr` and `orig`: two already-reduced child node indices and the original node index in the Song arena. No byte input and no input consumption at this entry.
entries.state_effects: Allocates arena nodes through `newApp` and `newNode` and may set the `SPENT` flag on arena exhaustion. The input node's children are not mutated and there is no rollback.
entries.refusal: Arena exhaustion is not a refusal at this entry: `newNode` sets `SPENT` and returns the inert `NIL` node (tag `0`), and the caller `verdict` maps `SPENT` to `FUEL`. Unsupported input: none at this entry.
entries.missing: MISSING: a checked Slang source-semantics link from `headReduce` to `Apeiron.Combinator.Comb.headReduce` and any executing refinement of the Song arena to `Apeiron.Combinator.Comb`. The `SPENT` and `NIL` arm is unresolved.

entries.title: normalize budgeted composition
entries.represented_program: The canonical `Apeiron.Combinator.Comb.normalize fuel c`: apply `reduceDeep` at most `fuel` times. The Song body composes `pass` to a fixed point or the source budget `FUEL_PASSES`.
entries.observation_relation: `Apeiron.Combinator.Comb.reduces_normalize` states `Reduces c (normalize fuel c)`. The Song pass composition is intended to implement the same iteration; `FUEL_PASSES` is a source constant, not a Lean `fuel` value, and no relation is checked.
entries.input_grammar: Arguments `root`, a Song node index, and `fuel`, a pass count. No byte input and no input consumption.
entries.state_effects: Increments the pass counter, resets and reuses the walk stack, and mutates the memo and memo-stamp arrays. There is no rollback.
entries.refusal: When the source budget is exhausted or `SPENT` is set, the body returns the current root and the caller reports `FUEL`. Unsupported input: none at this entry.
entries.missing: MISSING: a checked Slang source-semantics link from `normalize` to `Apeiron.Combinator.Comb.normalize` and any executing refinement. The source budget is not a Lean `fuel` value.

entries.title: hasRedex floor detector
entries.represented_program: The canonical `Apeiron.Combinator.Comb.hasRedex`: report whether the term carries a redex. The Song body walks the arena and reports `1` for the `TAG_I`, `TAG_IOTA`, `TAG_K`-head or `S`-head application shapes.
entries.observation_relation: `Apeiron.Combinator.Comb.normal_of_hasRedex_false` states that a clean report is a `NormalForm`. The Song body is intended to decide the same predicate; the relation is stated, not checked.
entries.input_grammar: Argument `root`, a Song node index. No byte input and no input consumption.
entries.state_effects: Resets and reuses the walk stack. On stack exhaustion the body sets `SPENT` and the caller reports a redex. There is no rollback.
entries.refusal: Stack exhaustion reports a redex (`1`) through `SPENT`; it is not a refusal. Unsupported input: none at this entry.
entries.missing: MISSING: a checked Slang source-semantics link from `hasRedex` to `Apeiron.Combinator.Comb.hasRedex` and any executing refinement. The `SPENT` report is unresolved.

entries.title: verdict normalize-and-compare
entries.represented_program: The canonical `Apeiron.Combinator.Comb.verdict fuel a b`: normalize two terms, detect remaining redexes and compare the floors, reporting `equal`, `distinct` or `fuel`. The Song body parses two prefix terms, normalizes both, detects redexes and structurally compares.
entries.observation_relation: `Apeiron.Combinator.Comb.verdict_decided_exact` states that when `verdict fuel a b` is not `fuel`, `equal` holds exactly when `Joinable a b` holds. The Song `EQUAL`, `DISTINCT`, `FUEL` and `PARSE` reports are intended to implement that decision; no denotation from the byte stream and arena to `Apeiron.Combinator.Comb` is established.
entries.input_grammar: Stdin bytes: `*` application, `k`, `s`, `i` and `u` atoms, digits `0..9` for variables, whitespace skipped. `readToken` consumes one byte per call and increments the position counter; `verdict` reads exactly two prefix terms and leaves trailing bytes unconsumed.
entries.state_effects: Mutates the arena, memo, stamps, counters and stacks in place. There is no rollback.
entries.refusal: `PARSE <pos>` with exit `2` on an unknown byte, an incomplete term or parse-stack overflow; `FUEL` with exit `3` on `SPENT` or a remaining redex; `RING` with exit `4` on startup ring-claim failure.
entries.missing: MISSING: a checked Slang source-semantics link from `verdict` to `Apeiron.Combinator.Comb.verdict` and any executing refinement. The byte grammar and the arena denotation are unresolved.
